ccbdb17913 (TASK-1956), round 2, all four items:
1 [blocking] BUG-2156 root-caused and fixed (stays superseded). RefreshLock::drop closed without LOCK_UN, so a sibling thread's pre-exec child kept the flock, read 2 lost it and served stale. Drop now unlocks. The inverted real-fork regression test fails on the old drop. The test also pins its read budget (ancestor-timeout branch) and prints branch counters on failure.
2 [minor] survivors() exempts a cloexec guard copy only for a scorer child in the scorer's pgid or its own (a mid-exec spawn). A CLONE_PARENT sibling inherits the scored command's pgid and is counted. New sibling test fails on the parent-only rule.
3 [minor] Missing python3 eprints an explicit SKIP (both python tests).
4 [cosmetic] as_tui_test_emitter restores the prior value through a drop guard (panic-safe).
Gates: check-ci-fast 32/32, check-ci-compile OK, clippy -D warnings clean, roots 9/9, cache modules 91/91. Aside: bug_1644_worktree_reader_serves_snapshot_behind_main_writer failed once under module-parallel load (elapsed<1s timing assert) and passes alone. It is unrelated, possibly worth filing.
subject: PR-2761 rework pushed
